audit_notes: Parameters physical. Diatomite contains iron and clay impurities that absorb in the blue/NIR; calcined, bleached diatomite reaches SR ~0.88-0.90 in thick layers; with BaSO4 co-filler SR ~0.92 new is plausible, the aged 20-year mean I set to alpha 0.14 (SR 0.86) instead of 0.12, since the silicate surface is porous and dust sticks. Emittance: amorphous silica has a reststrahlen reflection band at 8-10 um, so for a silica-rich coating eps ~0.90-0.93; set 0.92. Pore size parameter pi*d/lambda = pi*0.5e-6/0.55e-6 = 2.9 (Mie resonant scattering, efficient). Biot envelope 0.026. Simulation coefficient: sol-air excess (alpha*I - eps*dR)/h_o = (84-73.6)/20 = 0.52 K. Model: steady 1D conduction, analytical. Metric: heat flux to the room at x=1. Baseline: aged cool paint alpha 0.32, eps 0.90. Roof case; expected gain ~29%. Mechanical: silicate paints are proven on mineral substrates for 20+ years; not suitable on flexible metal roofs without primer. Audit passed.
